rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Portal Planalto publishes on 1 January 2015 (17:40) Rousseff's address from the Parlatório, datelined Palácio do Planalto 1 January 2015, in which she says she was re-elected and "I assume my second mandate with more hope than I assumed the first".
